title: Blood Sugar Level and Postoperative Agitations in Pediatric Surgery
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to investigate the effect of fasting time and blood glucose levels on postoperative agitations in pediatric patients who will undergo outpatient surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pediatric patients between 2-12 years of age who will undergo outpatient surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* ASA III-IV patients, patients with congenital malformation and developmental delays, or any neurological or cardiac diseases
study_population: The study will include children between 2-12 years of age who will be operated in the pediatric operating room. Circumcision, inguinal hernia, undescended testis, lymphadenopathy excision, cystoscopy, adenotonsillectomy cases will be included in the study.
